title: Frappe ERPNext before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 fails to enforce record-level authorization in several…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions before 15.124.2 and 16.x before 16.53.0 have a vulnerability where record-level authorization is not properly enforced in multiple endpoints, reports, and forms. This flaw allows authenticated users with low privileges to access or partially modify data beyond their assigned roles, including sensitive financial, stock, pricing, and contact information of other companies.
